scope: Explicit 0.4.0 browser checks on controlled derivatives of licensed photographs and legacy synthetic reports. No natural contamination claim.

checks.name: legacy-default-and-mirror
checks.steps: Loaded actual 59-image default (96 pairs) and mirror (107 pairs) reports; mirror-only search still explains four-distance matching.

checks.name: real-photo-orientation
checks.steps: Loaded 50 held-out-source derivatives / 131 pairs. Search camera-rotate90 gives 5 pairs. First is rotate90/original at distance 0; both unchanged-orientation previews decode to 256x256 with CSS transform none.

checks.name: undo-and-reload
checks.steps: Set unsure, undo to pending, set confirmed and Chinese QA note, reload and recover note/decision on selected pair.

checks.name: mobile-layout
checks.steps: 390x844 viewport; inspected full-page screenshot. Document/body scrollWidth 375, no page overflow.

notes: QA marks only identify known controlled source transforms.
